testDataNotes: Account numbers are synthetic, Luhn-valid values built on BINs from the chapter 8 Visa fleet BIN list unless a scenario tests another BIN.
Product codes come from Petroleum Appendix B: 001 Unleaded, 019 Diesel, 102 Car wash and 400 General merchandise.
Service code, CVV, issuer information and Track 1 discretionary data are synthetic; LRC bytes are omitted as in the source examples.

businessRequirements.title: Only the six listed transactions are supported
businessRequirements.statement: A Visa fleet transaction must be one of POS Purchase/Capture, POS Authorization Only, POS Return/Refund, POS Reversal/Void, CAT Purchase/Capture or CAT Authorization Only.

sourceAnchors.quote: The following transactions are supported for the Visa fleet card:

businessRequirements.title: The chapter 8 BIN list decides whether Visa fleet rules apply
businessRequirements.statement: Visa fleet rules apply only to accounts whose BIN is in the chapter 8 Visa fleet BIN list.
businessRequirements.interpretation: The chapter 8 list and the Appendix A ranges differ (VFC-R19); drafts follow the chapter 8 list.

sourceAnchors.quote: The following BIN’s within the specified Visa purchasing card BIN range are reserved for Visa fleet cards:

businessRequirements.title: The Merchant Profile credit option is active
businessRequirements.statement: BUYPASS receives Visa fleet transactions only when the Merchant Profile credit option is activated.

sourceAnchors.quote: In order for BUYPASS to receive Visa fleet card transactions, the Merchant Profile’s credit option must be activated.

businessRequirements.title: Visa fleet is allowed by Table Load card type or another method
businessRequirements.statement: The POS application allows Visa fleet cards only when the Table Load contains the Visa fleet card type or, without Table Load, another method allows them.
businessRequirements.interpretation: The Visa fleet Table Load card type is drafted as 020 (VFC-R01).

sourceAnchors.quote: The POS application must be able to read the corresponding Card Type code sent in the table load.
In the case where an application does not process a table load from BUYPASS, the application must provide a method to determine whether Visa fleet cards are allowed.

businessRequirements.title: Prompt Code combines the transaction type and card type 020
businessRequirements.statement: The Prompt Code is the one-character transaction type code followed by the three-digit Visa fleet card type code.

sourceAnchors.quote: Please refer to the applicable message format specifications for information about valid Prompt Codes for the Visa fleet card.

businessRequirements.title: Driver ID is 1 to 6 digits when the Service Prompt requires it
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Prompt requires a Driver ID, it is 1 to 6 unencrypted digits.

sourceAnchors.quote: If it is required, the Driver ID can have a length of 1– 6 digits. It should be unencrypted in the message format for BUYPASS.
The device must interpret the value in the Service Prompt field of the magnetic stripe to determine whether a Driver ID is required.
Prompt if Service Prompt = 3. Value: maximum of 6 digits.

businessRequirements.title: Odometer is 1 to 8 digits when required
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Prompt (or manual entry) requires an odometer reading, it is 1 to 8 digits.

sourceAnchors.quote: If it is required, the odometer reading can have a length of 1–8 digits.
Prompt if Service Prompt = 1, 2, 3, or 4. Value: maximum of 8 digits.

businessRequirements.title: Vehicle Number is 1 to 6 digits when the Service Prompt requires it
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Prompt requires a Vehicle Number, it is 1 to 6 digits and needs no authorization signature.

sourceAnchors.quote: If it is required, the Vehicle Number can have a length of 1–6 digits.
An authorization signature is not required for any Vehicle Number prompt.
Prompt if Service Prompt = 2. Value: maximum of 6 digits.

businessRequirements.title: ID is 1 to 6 digits when required
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Prompt (or manual entry) requires an ID, it is 1 to 6 digits.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Footnote 3 says a 6-digit ID; Appendix A says a maximum of 6 digits (VFC-R22).

sourceAnchors.quote: Prompt if Service Prompt = 1 or 6. Value: maximum of 6 digits.
3After prompt for ID, the cardholder enters the 6-digit numeric vehicle or driver/generic ID.

businessRequirements.title: The device prompts only for what the Service Prompt requires
businessRequirements.statement: For swiped Visa fleet cards, the device reads the Service Prompt in the last track position and prompts for exactly the data it requires.

sourceAnchors.quote: For a Visa Fleet Card transaction, the merchant must be able to provide the correct enhanced data information to the processor.
Visa fleet cards are required to use the last three positions of this field to provide instructions for customized prompts.

businessRequirements.title: Manual entry follows three unsuccessful reads and carries 16 digits
businessRequirements.statement: Manual entry is used only after three unsuccessful reads of the magnetic stripe and carries the 16-digit Visa fleet account number.
businessRequirements.interpretation: The source says swipe again up to three times and then refers to three attempts; this draft counts three attempts in total.

sourceAnchors.quote: Manual entry is allowed on a Visa fleet card transaction.
If unable to read the magnetic stripe after three attempts, the device should prompt for manual entry of the 16-digit Visa fleet card Account Number and prompt for an ID and the odometer reading.

businessRequirements.title: Manual entry is marked by an asterisk on receipt and journal
businessRequirements.statement: When manual entry is used, the receipt and journal show an asterisk before the account number.

sourceAnchors.quote: Note: If manual entry is used, this fact is indicated on the receipt and journal by an asterisk (*) before the Account Number.

businessRequirements.title: The device validates the expiration date
businessRequirements.statement: The device performs expiration date validation on every Visa fleet transaction.

sourceAnchors.quote: The device performs expiration date validation in a Visa fleet card transaction.

businessRequirements.title: The cardholder receipt suppresses the expiration date
businessRequirements.statement: The Visa fleet expiration date is not printed on the cardholder receipt.

sourceAnchors.quote: The Visa fleet card expiration date is suppressed on the cardholder receipt.

businessRequirements.title: Authorizations send an expiration value even for expired cards
businessRequirements.statement: Authorization Only transactions send an expiration value even when the card is expired.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Applied to Authorization Only transaction codes 3 and 5; whether purchases count as authorizations needs review.

sourceAnchors.quote: Note: For all authorizations, merchants must send a value even for expired cards.

businessRequirements.title: The full account number passes Mod 10
businessRequirements.statement: A Mod 10 check digit evaluation is performed on the full Visa fleet account number.

sourceAnchors.quote: For Visa fleet cards, a Mod 10 Check Digit evaluation is performed on the full Account Number.

businessRequirements.title: Track 2 is used first, then unaltered Track 1, then manual entry
businessRequirements.statement: An original transaction sends Track 2 when readable, otherwise unaltered Track 1 when readable, otherwise manual entry.

sourceAnchors.quote: The default track that is sent to BUYPASS on an original transaction should be Track 2.
The POS/CAT device must support a magnetic stripe reader capable of reading Track 1 and Track 2 data.

businessRequirements.title: Follow-on transactions carry partial Track 2
businessRequirements.statement: A follow-on transaction carries only the account number, an equals sign and the YYMM expiration date.

sourceAnchors.quote: Card data provided in a follow-on transaction must be partial Track 2 Data.

businessRequirements.title: Track 1 is sent without the Start Sentinel
businessRequirements.statement: Transmitted Track 1 data does not include the Start Sentinel.

sourceAnchors.quote: Note: The device should not transmit the Start Sentinel in any transaction.

businessRequirements.title: Track data follows the Visa fleet layouts
businessRequirements.statement: Track 1 and Track 2 data parse with a 16-digit PAN, separators, YYMM expiry and service code, and the fleet position before the Service Enhancement Indicator is 0.

businessRequirements.title: Service Enhancement Indicator 2 allows fuel only
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Enhancement Indicator is 2, only fuel Product Codes are allowed.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Fuel means the Appendix B fuel categories; values 3 to 9 follow Appendix A (all products) pending VFC-R20.

sourceAnchors.quote: The device must interpret the value of the Service Enhancement Indicator
Fuel only if Service Enhancement Indicator = 2. Fuel and maintenance if Service Enhancement Indicator = 1. All products allowed if Service Enhancement Indicator is any other value.

businessRequirements.title: Service Enhancement Indicator 1 allows fuel and maintenance only
businessRequirements.statement: When the Service Enhancement Indicator is 1, only fuel and maintenance Product Codes are allowed.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Maintenance means the Appendix B Automotive product/service codes 100-149 (VFC-R28).

sourceAnchors.quote: Fuel only if Service Enhancement Indicator = 2. Fuel and maintenance if Service Enhancement Indicator = 1. All products allowed if Service Enhancement Indicator is any other value.
1 = Fleet (fuel and maintenance only purchases)

businessRequirements.title: Each Product Code is unique in a transaction
businessRequirements.statement: Product codes in one Visa fleet transaction are unique.

sourceAnchors.quote: Note: A unique Product Code must be sent for each type of fuel purchase.

businessRequirements.title: Product Code Data is sent and sums to the transaction amount
businessRequirements.statement: Every Visa fleet transaction carries at least one product, and the product amounts sum to the transaction amount.
businessRequirements.interpretation: Drafted only for transactions without discounts, coupons or separate taxes.

sourceAnchors.quote: The Product Code Data must be sent in all fleet transactions. The sum of all the products in the product segment must equal the total transaction amount.

businessRequirements.title: Products use Petroleum Appendix B Product Codes
businessRequirements.statement: Every product is represented by a Product Code defined in Petroleum Appendix B.

sourceAnchors.quote: Any product in these tables should be represented in messages to BUYPASS by the Product Code assigned to it in the following tables.

businessRequirements.title: Keyed entry prompts only for ID and odometer and allows all products
businessRequirements.statement: When the card is keyed, the device prompts for ID and odometer only, does not prompt for Driver ID or Vehicle Number, and allows all products.
